changes_and_tradeoffs: Removed two small-input CB/CBS threads-setting comparisons that actually ran serially under the adaptive scheduler. Dense/sparse numerical parity remains; the arity-three site reducer check moved unchanged to test_sparse_reducers.py.

Replaced PGK-scale inputs in two output-lifecycle CLI tests with a six-tip, two-codon synthetic IQ-TREE-compatible bundle. Real CLI execution, joint inference, high-arity output archival, failed-run state, and input preservation assertions remain. Those two tests no longer incidentally exercise the complete PGK dataset; the separate scientific CI parity lane remains unchanged.

Both scan calibration modes still compare dense/sparse/disk-backed representations serially. Actual worker parity runs three representative cases (state-aware/full-scan/dense, endpoint/candidate-fixed/sparse, endpoint/full-scan/disk-backed), compares all result columns except worker diagnostics, and asserts two workers and four successful permutations. The complete calibration-by-representation product is not repeated in worker processes.

Process integration tests moved to tests/process. Ordinary runs skip collecting that directory; the serial lane collects only it. Collection rejects explicit process markers outside the directory. CI wheel coverage and extracted-sdist fallback use the same selection.
One unsupported-checksum CLI test now invokes the real parser/handler in process. Its error/exit-status contract remains; subprocess/log-file boundaries are covered by the remaining CLI tests.
Known-mean count-null trial counts, draw counts, scientific thresholds, inference defaults, and performance baselines remain unchanged.
